Hi everyone! I'm Francesco De Simone, welcome to my channel! Certified massage therapist in Milano (Italy), also offering mobile massage services at your home, bringing you authentic ASMR massage experiences. 📩 instagram.com/francesco.ds.massaggio Contact me on Instagram to book a massage! 🏠

What You'll Find:
💆🏻‍♂️ Professional massage on real people
🤫 No talking ASMR sessions
👁️POV experiences and multiple camera angles
🇮🇹 Italian massage techniques
✨ Stress relief & sleep content

Perfect for sleep, stress relief, ASMR tingles, and wellness enthusiasts!
🔔 Subscribe for weekly professional massage ASMR sessions
💤 Use headphones for the best ASMR experience
🇮🇹 Authentic Italian massage therapy techniques

As a licensed massage therapist, I combine professional training with ASMR to help you relax and unwind. Each video showcases authentic techniques in a therapeutic environment designed for ultimate relaxation. Content for relaxation/educational purposes only. Not medical advice.
